qa_pairs.question: Where can one find a definitive, up-to-date, free online wiki reference for C++?
qa_pairs.answer: A definitive, up-to-date, free online wiki reference for C++ (and its C Standard Library subset) is available at cppreference.com, accessible via http://en.cppreference.com/w/.

qa_pairs.question: What type of content does cppreference.com provide regarding programming languages?
qa_pairs.answer: Cppreference.com offers a definitive, up-to-date, free online wiki reference specifically for the C++ programming language and its C Standard Library subset.
